title: test_authentication_login_endpoint
description: Verify that the /api/v1/auth/login endpoint correctly authenticates users with valid credentials and returns a valid JWT access token and token type.

title: test_authentication_logout_endpoint
description: Verify that the /api/v1/auth/logout endpoint successfully logs out an authenticated user and invalidates the JWT token.

title: test_authentication_google_login_flow
description: Verify the Google OAuth2 login flow including /api/v1/auth/google, /api/v1/auth/google/start, and /api/v1/auth/google/callback endpoints for correct handling of id_token, redirect, and callback parameters.

title: test_user_registration_endpoint
description: Verify that the /api/v1/usuarios/register endpoint allows new user registration with valid data and returns appropriate success response.

title: test_user_profile_retrieval_and_update
description: Verify that authenticated users can retrieve their profile via /api/v1/usuarios/me and update their profile via /api/v1/usuarios/profile with valid data.

title: test_user_role_management
description: Verify that authorized users can create new roles via /api/v1/usuarios/roles and change user roles via /api/v1/usuarios/{usr_id}/role with proper role-based access control.

title: test_children_profile_management
description: Verify that authenticated users can create, retrieve, update, and delete child profiles using /api/v1/children, /api/v1/children/{nin_id}, and manage anthropometric data and nutritional status.

title: test_allergy_types_and_assignment
description: Verify that allergy types can be queried and created via /api/v1/alergias/tipos and allergies can be assigned to children via /api/v1/children/{nin_id}/allergies.

title: test_nutritional_entities_management
description: Verify that nutritional entities and their types can be listed and queried via /api/v1/entidades and /api/v1/entidades/tipos endpoints.

title: test_machine_learning_nutritional_summary_generation
description: Verify that the /api/v1/ml/summary endpoint generates valid nutritional summaries using ML or LLM based on input features and scores, and returns the summary text and used_llm flag.
